review.scope: All listed native-frame sheets visually reviewed, including partial final pages; full-action surveys use every second source frame.
review.frame_bounds_meaning: Inclusive reviewed source-frame window, not an exact inferred contact or internal damage activation frame.
limitations: Source frames are 30 fps; dense sampling cannot recover sub-frame events, hidden limbs, calibrated world distances or original hitboxes.
Overlapping windows and the two shared project motifs must not be counted as independent original attacks.
Original footage has edits, replay and flare occlusion; visual sequence confidence does not certify runtime animation or damage.

implemented_runtime_changes: Normal three combo families use their configured active windows with unchanged per-target hit IDs
Visual clones spawn after the authoritative position locks and before impact; their authored contact tick 4 maps to the original server hit tick
A full visual budget replaces the oldest completed clone contact rather than dropping a new pending one; pending and same-tick contacts stay protected
Pending clone contacts are cancelled when their persisted parent action sequence ends or changes; completed contacts retain their fade
Shared blade windows use the left sword for both bloodflame sword events, the right sword for ring release, and both swords for earthheave withdrawal
Suspended bloodflame tear spans the frozen shape width before its existing explosion; ground telegraph and damage geometry remain unchanged

absolute_tick_authorization.scope: All skills use explicit windup, release and recovery ticks for each component; remove percentage speed configuration, calibrate defaults against observed original-game rhythm, prioritize unfinished motion work

timing_authorization.scope: Rebuild total duration, windup, hit intervals, recovery and default cast speed using observable reference rhythm; keep damage, ranges and hit counts unchanged

native_frame_review.observation: 右脚落下、躯干前压，随后扬石；后接高位剑劈排除。

stomp.observed: 身体先向承重左腿偏移，右膝抬高，双剑向两侧保持平衡；右脚快速落下，躯干前压，脚掌接地后前方碎石与尘土才扬起。紧接的高位剑劈是后续动作，不属于踩地本身。
stomp.animation_target: 抬右膝与左腿承重明确，脚掌接地对齐原始14tick事件，地面碎石稍后展开；不添加后接剑击。
stomp.confidence: native-frame footfall window reviewed; visible right-foot plant and following debris, not internal hitbox timing

native_frame_review.observation: 蓄光后第一次向前切入，刀弧先于后出的光效。
交替第二刀，身体随剑切向另一侧，为旋扫收剑。
补查窗口：约199.2秒双剑横扫身前，随后向侧面回带；不是下一次起跳。
约200.0秒第二次腰部横扫，挥过后收剑。原候选序号不代表第几次旋扫。
此窗已经收腿起跳，撤销此前第二次旋扫接触的标签；不增加命中。
跳跃落斩向前下压，落地强光和碎石遮住部分剑身。
与落地窗部分重叠，密集光柱随后出现，不作为额外本体刀击。

promised_consort.observed: 先在远处高位蓄剑聚光，再向玩家切入，两次交替斩击后把双剑带到身体一侧，转腰旋扫并换侧回带；最后双脚离地，跳起后持剑下压张开，落地时出现强光和碎石，紧随其后是密集竖直光柱。约204.1秒开始淡入重放。
promised_consort.animation_target: 保持两次开路、两次旋扫和一次跳跃落斩的五次本体合同；旋扫间加入清楚回带，减少匀速空转。原项目的两次分身回切与光环作为改编保留，不从光柱画面推断新增次数。
promised_consort.confidence: native-frame windows and supplemental first spin reviewed; second spin and jump relabeled; full-body turns partly obscured by hair

native_frame_review.observation: 双剑高举聚光，随后进入俯身压缩；不是伤害窗口。
下压后爆发起跳离开画面，光迹残留；不据此增加离场伤害。
可确认斜向细光迹；不能将整个窗口统一标为地面开始变亮或精确锁点。
再入强光先出现，本体关节被遮住，不能重建精确落地姿势。
闪光后的地面爆发与飞石；无法由画面测出Minecraft伤害半径。

consort_meteor.observed: 双剑从两侧高举，在头顶聚起白金光，随后俯身下压、双剑向外展开，爆发式起跳离场；镜头里只剩跑位和余光。回归先可辨斜向细光迹，然后强光与地面爆发。252.3秒之后换成抬头看星点的重放：小光点突然出现十字星芒，再沿斜向光迹落下。
consort_meteor.animation_target: 改清楚举剑聚光、俯身压缩和离场起跳，保留低光停顿、星芒再入及落地缓冲。121原始tick落地、21.6/31.2/36格半径和落地前免伤不变。
consort_meteor.confidence: native-frame departure and reentry windows reviewed; return pose obscured by flare, replay is not a second cast

native_frame_review.observation: 共用掀地连段的双剑入地和低位停留，不是另一套独立原作短招。
双剑自低处向上拔起，随后飞石；四列圣光属于项目保留的强化结构。

enhanced_earthheave.observed: 此ID是项目独立拆出的强化掀地。可核实的原作动作依据是掀地连段末尾双剑入地、低位停留与向上拔剑；二阶段光柱顺序另以连舞落地片段核对。没有证据声称这两段视频含完全对应的独立短招。
enhanced_earthheave.animation_target: 保留20tick入地及既有裂地、四列圣光的数值合同，修正其后从低位拔起的手臂路径。原作入地到拔剑的独立伤害分配不擅自迁入本技能。
enhanced_earthheave.confidence: native-frame shared motif reviewed; project adaptation, independent original move identity unverified

native_frame_review.observation: 张臂升空和地面蓄光，非连续挥剑。
蓄光后的主闪，晚于地面开始变亮；亮帧不能替代内部判定。
主闪后竖直光柱陆续出现，和主爆分开记录。

与本体挥后窗重叠，沿路光柱后出，不重复认作本体接触。
